## Loading the data

```{r}
#library(ANCOMBC)
library(DESeq2)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(TreeSummarizedExperiment)
source("../../Utility Functions/utilities.R")
```


```{r}
shotgun_data_path <- list.files("./CNT_HFD_HFE_INT/P200045_NEW/report_taxonomy/comp1/taxa_profiles/", full.names = TRUE)

organ_dt <- lapply(c("cecum", "colon"), function(organ){
    shotgun_data <- lapply(shotgun_data_path, function(shotgun_path){
        shotgun_table <- read.table(shotgun_path, header = TRUE, row.names = 1, sep = "\t")
        colnames(shotgun_table)[38] <- paste0(colnames(shotgun_table)[38], "I")
        if(organ == "cecum"){
            shotgun_table <- shotgun_table[grepl("CE", colnames(shotgun_table))]
            colnames(shotgun_table) <- gsub("CE", "X", colnames(shotgun_table))
        } else if(organ == "colon"){
            shotgun_table <- shotgun_table[grepl("X", colnames(shotgun_table))]
        }
        shotgun_table <- shotgun_table[rowMeans(shotgun_table) != 0,]
        shotgun_table
    })
    names(shotgun_data) <- gsub("_comp1.txt", "", basename(shotgun_data_path))
    shotgun_data
})
names(organ_dt) <- c("cecum", "colon")

```

## Creating the metadata

```{r}
metadata_list <- lapply(organ_dt, function(organ){
    lapply(organ, function(hierarchy){ 
        hierarchy <- data.frame("samplename" = colnames(hierarchy))
        hierarchy$group <- substr(x = hierarchy$samplename, start = 5, stop = 5)
        hierarchy$group <- factor(hierarchy$group, levels = c("C", "H", "I", "E"), 
                                      labels = c("CNT", "HFD", "INT", "HFE"))
        hierarchy
    })
})
```

```{r}
        # summ_exp <- TreeSummarizedExperiment(assays = list("counts" = as.matrix(hierarchy_data)),
```

```{r}
lapply(names(shotgun_data), function(organ_names){
    organ <- shotgun_data[[organ_names]]
    lapply(names(organ), function(hierarchy_names){
        
        group_var <- colData(organ[[hierarchy_names]])[["group"]]
        hierarchy <- organ[[hierarchy_names]]
        alpha_div <- vegan::diversity(x = assay(hierarchy), index = "shannon", MARGIN = 2)
        
        boxplot(alpha_div ~ group_var, main = paste(organ_names, hierarchy_names, sep = "_"), 
                xlab = "Group", ylab = "Shannon Index")
    })
})
```

## Test aggregated phylum

```{r}
agglomerated_dt <- lapply(names(shotgun_data), function(organ_names){
    
    hierarchy_sp <- shotgun_data[[organ_names]]$species
    agglomerated_dt <- mia::agglomerateByRank(x = hierarchy_sp, rank = "Phylum")
    alpha_div <- vegan::diversity(x = assay(agglomerated_dt), index = "shannon", MARGIN = 2)
    group_var <- agglomerated_dt$group
    
    boxplot(alpha_div ~ group_var, main = paste("Aggregated", organ_names, "phylum", sep = "_"), 
            xlab = "Group", ylab = "Shannon Index")
    agglomerated_dt
})
names(agglomerated_dt) <- names(shotgun_data)

n1 <- rownames(agglomerated_dt$cecum)
n2 <- gsub("Phylum:", "", rownames(shotgun_data$cecum$phylum))
n2[!n2 %in% n1]


```



```{r}
# Filtering taxons not present in atleast 80% of one group
shotgun_data_proc <- lapply(names(shotgun_data), function(organ_name){
    organ <- shotgun_data[[organ_name]]

    organ_filt <- lapply(names(organ), function(hierarchy_name){
        
        hierarchy <- organ[[hierarchy_name]]
        hierarchy_metadata <- colData(organ[[hierarchy_name]])
        
        keep_vars <- apply(assay(hierarchy), 1, function(dt_var){
            group_dt <- tapply(dt_var, INDEX = hierarchy_metadata$group, function(var_group){
                sum(var_group != 0)/length(var_group)
            })
            
            any(group_dt >= 0.8)    
        })
        
        hierarchy[keep_vars,]
    })
    names(organ_filt) <- names(organ)
    organ_filt
})
names(shotgun_data_proc) <- names(shotgun_data)
```

```{r}
lapply(names(shotgun_data_proc), function(organ_names){
    organ <- shotgun_data_proc[[organ_names]]
    lapply(names(organ), function(hierarchy_names){
        group_var <- colData(organ[[hierarchy_names]])[["group"]]
        hierarchy <- organ[[hierarchy_names]]
        alpha_div <- vegan::diversity(x = assay(hierarchy), index = "shannon", MARGIN = 2)
        
        boxplot(alpha_div ~ group_var, main = paste(organ_names, hierarchy_names, sep = "_"))
    })
})
```

```{r}
shotgun_data_exp <- lapply(names(shotgun_data_proc), function(organ_name){
    organ_data <- shotgun_data_proc[[organ_name]]
  
    organ_results <- lapply(names(organ_data), function(hierarchy_name){
        hierarchy <- organ_data[[hierarchy_name]]
        hierarchy_meta <- colData(hierarchy)
        
        names_comp <- apply(t(combn(levels(hierarchy_meta$group), m = 2))[,2:1], 1, paste, collapse = "-")
        # comp_mat <- as.data.frame(matrix(NA, ncol = 2, nrow = length(names_comp)))
        # rownames(comp_mat) <- names_comp
        # colnames(comp_mat) <- c("mean rank diff", "pval")
        # 
        #hierarchy <- as.data.frame(clr(t(hierarchy)))
        
        #pca(mat = hierarchy, metadata = organ_meta, scale = FALSE)
        
        hierarchy_deseq <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(countData = as.data.frame(assay(hierarchy)),
                                                  colData = hierarchy_meta, design = ~ group + 0)
        hierarchy_deseq <- DESeq(hierarchy_deseq, test = "Wald")
        results_list <- lapply(names_comp, function(comp_name){
            comp_vec <- c("group", strsplit(comp_name, "-")[[1]])
            results(hierarchy_deseq, contrast = comp_vec, pAdjustMethod = "fdr")
        })
        
        # hierarchy_ancombc2 <- SummarizedExperiment(assays = hierarchy, 
        #                                            colData = hierarchy_meta)
        # ancom_res <- ancombc2(data = hierarchy_ancombc2, fix_formula = "~ group + 0", p_adj_method = "fdr", group = "group")
        # 
        names(results_list) <- names_comp
        results_list <- do.call(cbind, results_list)
        rowData(hierarchy) <- cbind(rowData(hierarchy), results_list)
        hierarchy
    })
    names(organ_results) <- names(organ_data)
    organ_results
})
names(shotgun_data_exp) <- names(shotgun_data_proc)

saveRDS(shotgun_data_exp, "./shotgun_results_list.rds")
```
